Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:193216
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 45075 of 2024

Applicant :- Smt. Jasoda Devi
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Markandey Rai,Pradeep Kumar Rai,Sandeep Kumar Rai
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Neelam Singh Chauhan,Rakesh Kumar Singh Chauhan
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Pradeep Kumar Rai, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Rakesh Kumar Singh Chauhan, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA for the State.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 236 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Baldev, District Mathura during pendency of the trial.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused in the present matter along with husband and sister-in-law of the deceased.
4.

He further submits that actually about six months before deceased i.e. daughter-in-law of the applicant delivered a child but unfortunately, the child had died and after the death of the child she remained in depression and only due to this reason she consumed some poisonous substance and died and after her death only being mother-in-law of the deceased, applicant has been made accused Smt. 1 in the present matter.

sentences.text:
5. He further submits, during post mortem cause of death could not be ascertained and viscera was preserved but now viscera report is on record and from its perusal, it reflects, due to consumption of insecticide deceased died, therefore, it cannot be said that it is not a case of suicidal death.
6.

He further submits, neither in the FIR nor in the statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
informant could disclose any specific demand of dowry and this fact also suggests that it is not a case of dowry death.
7. He further submits that applicant is a lady and there is no specific allegation against her and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter she is in jail since 27.08.2024.

8. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and her daughter-in-law died within three years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that there is no specific allegation against the applicant.
They further could not dispute the fact that neither in the FIR nor in the statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. informant could disclose any specific demand of dowry.

9. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant however submitted that from the perusal of the statement of the mother of the deceased recorded during investigation, it reflects, there was demand of Rs. 2 lakhs.
He however further could not dispute the fact that deceased died due to consumption of insecticide.
10. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. However, daughter-in-law of the applicant died within three years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.
12. Further, neither in the FIR nor in the statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. informant could disclose any specific demand of dowry.
Further, considering the viscera report of the deceased at this stage, it cannot be said that it is not a case of suicide.
13. Further, applicant is a lady and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter she is in jail since 27.08.2024.

14. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
15. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

sentences.text:
Let the applicant - Smt. Jasoda Devi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
17. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

18. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
